title: Remove all-pets fallback and add crit circles around destructibles
description: 1. Remove the all-pets fallback in ZoneService.attackDestructible so only assigned pets deal damage. 2. Add crit circle mechanic: clicking a destructible spawns 3-5 glowing circles that orbit it; clicking a circle triggers a crit (2x damage) validated server-side.
steps: Remove all-pets fallback in ZoneService.attackDestructible (0 damage if no pets assigned)
Add crit window tracking to ZoneService (_critWindows per player/destructible)
Add CritAttackDestructible remote function to Main.server.lua with rate limit
Add critAttackDestructible method to ZoneService (validates crit window, deals 2 damage)
Add crit circle spawning in Main.client.lua (on destructible click, spawn circles via EffectsController)
Add crit circle click detection in Main.client.lua (raycast for crit circles, fire CritAttackDestructible)
Add spawnCritCircles and related methods to EffectsController (orbit movement, neon material, lifetime)
Add crit hit visual feedback to EffectsController (flash, gold CRIT popup, sound)
acceptance_criteria: No fallback to all equipped pets in attackDestructible - 0 damage if no pets assigned
Clicking a destructible spawns 3-5 glowing circles around it (client-side)
Circles orbit randomly around the destructible for 2-3 seconds then disappear
Circles are 2-3 studs, Neon material, yellow/orange/white colors
Clicking a crit circle removes it with a flash effect and deals 2 damage (server-validated)
Server tracks crit windows (2-3 seconds after click attack) per player per destructible
CritAttackDestructible remote has rate limiting (0.2s cooldown)
Gold/orange CRIT! 2 text popup on crit hit
New circles spawn on each destructible click (not on circle click)
findings: Network mode is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY - pure Luau project, no external dependencies needed
Crit circles use CanCollide=true so workspace:Raycast detects them for click handling
Crit window duration is 3 seconds matching the circle lifetime (2-3s) to ensure valid server validation
showDamageText in PetController extended with optional isCrit parameter for gold popup styling
CritAttackDestructible rate limited at 0.2s via central rate limiter in Main.server.lua
